title: Sardine and white bean salad
summary: Sardine and white bean salad is a mediterranean dinner built around sardines in spring water and canned cannellini beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook sardines in spring water for Sardine and white bean salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cherry tomatoes alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss canned cannellini beans with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.
Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Sardine and white bean salad straight away. Taste Sardine and white bean salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
